name: Recruit Order Test (fast XP)
description: Adds a 20x XP acceleration on top, so a recruitment shuffle can be checked without a full playthrough: every character's level thresholds are cut to 5% of vanilla. It is a testing aid and nothing else - the thresholds are the only thing it touches, so levels, stats, abilities and their unlock levels all behave exactly as in recruit_order_test. Use it to watch which abilities each recruit actually gains and when; use the plain profile for anything you intend to play.
